title: Card-Not-Present Fraud
description: Fraud involving payment card information used in an online or other remote transaction where the physical card is not presented. Stolen card details can be used to attempt unauthorized purchases.
indicators: Unauthorized online payment activity
Payment behavior inconsistent with expected customer activity
Repeated suspicious payment attempts
recommended_actions: Apply additional verification to suspicious payments
Review related transaction activity
Use fraud detection controls before approving high-risk payments

title: Account Takeover
description: Account takeover occurs when an unauthorized person gains access to another person's online account with the goal of stealing money or information.
indicators: Unauthorized withdrawals or expenditures
Unexpected account activity
Suspicious changes involving an existing financial account
recommended_actions: Use multi-factor authentication
Monitor accounts for irregular activity
Contact the financial institution when unauthorized activity is detected

title: Card Testing
description: Card testing is fraudulent activity in which stolen or generated card information is tested to determine whether the card details are valid before they are used for other fraudulent purchases.
indicators: Spike in failed or blocked payments
Large numbers of card validation attempts
Repeated small payment attempts
Unusually high payment failure rates
recommended_actions: Apply rate limits
Use CAPTCHA where appropriate
Limit repeated card or customer creation attempts
Monitor payment failures and authorization activity

title: Identity Fraud
description: Identity theft occurs when someone uses another person's personal or financial information without permission. Stolen information may be used to make purchases, open accounts, or impersonate the victim.
indicators: Accounts or transactions the customer does not recognize
Unexpected changes involving financial accounts
Use of personal or financial information without authorization
recommended_actions: Review financial accounts and credit reports
Report confirmed identity theft
Consider fraud alerts or credit freezes when appropriate
Secure accounts that may have been compromised

title: Phishing and Social Engineering
description: Phishing uses deceptive messages that appear to come from trusted organizations to persuade victims to reveal personal or financial information, visit fraudulent sites, or interact with malicious content.
indicators: Unexpected requests for personal or financial information
Messages asking users to urgently click links
Messages impersonating trusted organizations
Requests to confirm account or payment information through unexpected communications
recommended_actions: Do not use links or attachments in suspicious messages
Contact organizations using independently verified contact information
Use multi-factor authentication
Report suspected phishing attempts

title: Transaction Velocity Abuse
description: Transaction velocity risk occurs when an unusually large number of transactions or payment attempts happen within a short period. High transaction volume can be associated with fraudulent activity and automated abuse.
indicators: Large volume of transactions over a short period
Repeated payment attempts
Rapid increases in failed or blocked payments
recommended_actions: Apply transaction rate limits
Monitor payment velocity
Review unusually concentrated transaction activity
Apply additional controls to high-risk activity

title: Stolen Payment Card Fraud
description: Stolen payment card fraud involves unauthorized use of compromised card information to make payments without the legitimate cardholder's permission.
indicators: Payments later reported as unauthorized
Payment activity inconsistent with the cardholder's expected behavior
Card information associated with suspicious payment attempts
recommended_actions: Apply fraud screening before payment approval
Use additional verification for high-risk payments
Monitor disputes and unauthorized-payment reports

title: Merchant Fraud
description: Merchant-related fraud can involve a merchant or associated party participating in fraudulent activity, submitting prohibited transactions, generating excessive fraudulent disputes, or colluding with others to commit fraud.
indicators: Abnormal dispute activity
Suspicious merchant transaction patterns
Evidence of merchant collusion
Transactions inconsistent with the merchant's represented business activity
recommended_actions: Review suspicious merchant activity
Monitor dispute patterns
Investigate inconsistencies in merchant transaction behavior
Escalate suspected merchant abuse for further review

title: Transaction Laundering
description: Transaction laundering occurs when the source of submitted payment transactions is misrepresented or when transactions are submitted on behalf of another merchant without appropriate authorization.
indicators: Transactions inconsistent with the merchant's stated business
Possible submission of transactions for another merchant
Misrepresentation of the source of payment activity
recommended_actions: Investigate merchant transaction sources
Compare payment activity with the merchant's declared business
Escalate suspected transaction laundering for compliance review

title: Unauthorized Payment Fraud
description: Unauthorized payment fraud occurs when payment credentials are used without the legitimate owner's permission, potentially resulting in payments that the cardholder later identifies and disputes as fraudulent.
indicators: Payments not recognized by the legitimate cardholder
Unexpected payment activity
Fraud-related disputes following completed payments
recommended_actions: Review suspicious transactions
Apply additional verification for high-risk payments
Monitor disputes and related transaction activity
Use fraud prevention controls before approving suspicious payments
